Title: Nikhil's Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Rajesh - 43 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Anjali and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nikhil throws the ball to Mother.]

Anjali (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Nikhil catches the ball.]

Nikhil: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Nikhil kicks the football hard.]

Rajesh: "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil goes down the slide.]

Nikhil (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil plays with his dog.]

Nikhil: "Careful!"

[Nikhil does push-ups.]

Nikhil: "What happened?"

[Nikhil does yoga on a mat.]

Nikhil (excited): "Okay, Dad."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Anjali and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil eats his breakfast at the table.]

Rajesh: "I knew it!"

[Nikhil takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

[Nikhil drinks a glass of water.]

Anjali (excited): "Show me too!"

[Nikhil sips hot tea from a cup.]

Rajesh: "One more time!"

[Nikhil gulps down a glass of milk.]

Rajesh (gently): "Well done!"

[Nikhil serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Nikhil: "What a day to remember!"
